purpose: Evaluate ordinary-language source retrieval, useful first-answer baselines, scoped legal interpretation and three-turn corrected-fact continuity on an integrated candidate through the website acceptance path.
accessPolicy: Keep reserved prompts, keys, titles and governing references private from candidate-authoring work until candidate freeze is confirmed and any known-regression changes are settled. Readiness/counts/hashes may be shared beforehand.
freezeOrder: Review canonical operative text, scope, exceptions and tables.
Audit actual app canonical body resolution with no provider/network calls.
Freeze heldout, keys, packets, audit, protocol and manifest hashes.
Confirm separately frozen application candidate/hosted assets and authorized website path before exposing reserved content or generating paid answers.

generationPolicy.providerBudgetAndConsentOwner: Root agent/user; this protocol grants no spend authorization.
generationPolicy.models: Use the separately frozen current Permitext configuration; no model overrides or reference-seeded retrieval.
generationPolicy.testProject: Isolated synthetic project per conversation, not real 1070 Southern Boulevard facts.
generationPolicy.facts: Load initial structured facts and retain full conversation. Explicit later user corrections replace contradictory initial values; do not rewrite prior answers or keys afterward.

grading.correct: Actual operative conclusion, factual corrections, thresholds/conditions and supporting citations are materially right.
grading.appropriate_clarification: A genuinely needed missing fact is identified after a useful supported baseline; source retrieval failure or asking for already supplied facts does not qualify.
grading.withheld: Substantive available answer is not delivered, including openai-mode nonanswers or generic evidence-boundary text without the available baseline.
grading.materially_wrong: Wrong rule/scope/row/threshold/correction, unsupported applicable conclusion, or affirmative false absence claim.
grading.minor_issue: Narrow presentational/citation/explanation imperfection without a material operative error.
grading.fixture_ambiguous: Source/key problem prevents fair adjudication; preserve raw output, flag ambiguity and retain original key/hash rather than tune afterward.
grading.evidence: Review actual writer packet clauses, full table rows/columns/notes, scoped applicability and final answer; source IDs and verifier pass are not ground truth.
grading.strictPass: correct plus appropriate_clarification; report denominators and ambiguous cases explicitly.
grading.reviewerLimitation: Assistant source review, not licensed professional adjudication.

immutability: Keep all failures and original scores; no tuning, key edits or selective replacement after reserved outputs are seen. A revised implementation requires fresh reserved material and a new freeze.
limitations: All six code families and their broad professional topics have appeared in prior campaigns.
Earlier campaigns sometimes stored whole chapter bodies or canonical parents; reference-disjointness does not establish previously unseen legal text.
The new cohort tests new wording, projects, corrections and exact operative provisions, not independence from all prior legal-source exposure.
The two BC scenarios share Chapter 7; successive turns within each conversation and related code families are correlated.
These are assistant-authored, source-reviewed fictional cases; neither statistical 95% product accuracy nor licensed adjudication is established.
